Triton one-program n=32 Householder QR attempt builds but validation fails with NaN/Inf Q on n=32.
Adjusted Triton n=32 Householder signs and zero-norm guard; still validation_error with NaN/Inf Q on n=32.
Tried safer Triton n=32 division guards, but validation hit Triton compilation error because tl.sign is unavailable.
Replaced tl.sign with conditional sign and kept safe denominators; Triton n=32 QR still fails validation with NaN/Inf Q.

Brief exhausted without a valid candidate. Four Triton n=32 one-program Householder variants were attempted; all built except one tl.sign compile issue, and all numerically-validating variants failed test.0 because householder_product(H,tau) contained NaN/Inf. The parent torch.geqrf remains the best safe score at 117001.396827 us. Suggested next brief: avoid full compact-Householder in Triton unless debugged against PyTorch convention offline, or target structure/fallback detection rather than replacing n=32/176/352.
Lifecycle close for duplicate brief_start after completed worker notification; brief 0 exhausted with no valid candidate.

Implement a Triton/PyTorch preclassifier for n=512 clustered trailing-column or triangular-ish inputs: cheap norm or strict-lower scans, exact padded compact shortcuts only when safe, otherwise untouched torch.geqrf.
Added n=512 trailing-column norm and strict-lower preclassifier with exact shortcuts/fallback; validates but benchmark regresses to 117098.679 us from detection overhead/no shortcut hits.
Exact n=512 rankdef preclassifier detects all-zero trailing 128 columns, factors the first 384 columns, pads compact H/tau, and falls back otherwise; validates and improves geomean to 114643.147 us.

Extended n=512 preclassifier with trailing-half threshold for clustered-like inputs; validates but is slower than rankdef-only at 114767.067 us, likely due extra reductions and no clustered shortcut hit.

Brief exhausted. Best commit is 2c9bd3de with exact n=512 rankdef zero-tail preclassifier: detects all-zero trailing 128 columns, factors first 384 columns, pads compact H/tau, and falls back otherwise; validates and improves linalg/qr_v2 from 117001.397 to 114643.147 us. A broader clustered trailing-half threshold also validated but was slower at 114767.067 us, so HEAD is reset to the rankdef-only best. Suggested next brief: keep rankdef shortcut and investigate lower-overhead detection or a true clustered compact shortcut; thresholding clustered tails did not hit enough to pay for reductions.

Reduce detection overhead in the n=512 rankdef zero-tail shortcut without changing fallback behavior: use the cheapest exact tail all-zero guard, cached shape/stride checks, and hit-probability early exits, then benchmark against 114643 us without dense-case regressions.
Added last-column exact-zero sentinel before full n=512 rankdef tail scan; validates but regresses to 114694.610 us, so extra reduction does not pay off.
Replaced abs().amax zero-tail guard with count_nonzero()==0; validates but regresses to 114807.791 us, so count_nonzero is slower for this detector.
Replaced abs().amax zero-tail guard with torch.all(tail == 0); validates and is closest alternative at 114658.063 us, but still slightly slower than parent 114643.147 us.

Micro brief exhausted. Tested three exact n=512 zero-tail detector variants against parent 114643.147 us: last-column sentinel + full scan (114694.610), count_nonzero (114807.791), and torch.all(tail == 0) (114658.063). None beat the parent abs().amax()==0 guard, so HEAD is restored to parent 2c9bd3de. Parent remains best safe candidate for this line; future work should seek a fused/custom detector or avoid additional reductions.

Specialize only the n=32 path from the global best by profiling overhead, then try a fixed-size CUDA or Triton compact-H QR kernel that preserves torch.geqrf factors exactly; target launch and tiny-matrix traffic, keeping larger paths unchanged unless validation and benchmark are neutral.
Added fixed-size n=32 CUDA compact-H QR attempt, but validation guard rejected at banned stream reference in launch wrapper before correctness testing.
Retried fixed-size n=32 CUDA compact-H QR without explicit stream; build passed but validation subprocess failed at load_inline because ninja was unavailable in eval runtime.
Added Triton one-program n=32 compact-H QR path on global-best parent; build passed but validation failed on n=32 with NaN/Inf Q from householder_product.

Brief exhausted with no valid n=32 specialization. CUDA fixed-size compact-H kernel attempt was first rejected for banned stream usage, then a stream-free load_inline version failed in validation runtime because ninja was unavailable; Triton one-program n=32 Householder QR built but failed correctness with NaN/Inf Q from householder_product. Larger paths were left unchanged and HEAD is restored to parent/global-best 13f6682f. Suggest not pursuing n=32 compact-H further without an offline factor-convention test harness or a leaderboard-compatible precompiled extension path.

Port f1fd083's n=352 batch=40 dense chunking path with four batch-10 GEQRF calls onto b3da92e's n=512/n=1024 structured routing; preserve exact shape guards, avoid broad dispatcher changes, benchmark the full active set, and keep only if n=352 improves without regressing b3da92e's wins.
Ported f1fd083 n=352 batch=40 four-way chunked GEQRF onto b3da92e n=512/n=1024 structured routing; validates and scores 108420.502 us, slightly slower than b3da92e 108416.997 us.

Combine brief exhausted. The requested stack of f1fd083 n=352 batch=40 four-way chunked GEQRF onto b3da92e n=512/n=1024 structured routing validated, but benchmarked at 108420.502 us versus b3da92e's 108416.997 us, so it slightly regressed despite the n=352 improvement. HEAD restored to b3da92e. Suggest keeping b3da92e as best for this pair; n=352 chunking is not worth the geomean tradeoff on top of b3da92e.

Target only dense n=2048 batch=8 from b3da92e by adding shape-specific GEQRF dispatch that reduces large-batch overhead through smaller chunks, workspace or call-grouping tradeoffs, while preserving all structured and mixed routing; keep only if the full active benchmark improves.
Added exact batch=8,n=2048 dense chunk=4 GEQRF dispatch; validates but n2048 worsens to ~75098 us and full geomean regresses to 108454.780 us.
Changed exact batch=8,n=2048 dense dispatch to chunk=2 GEQRF; validates but n2048 remains ~75098 us and geomean regresses to 108480.349 us.

Macro brief exhausted. Exact batch=8,n=2048 dense GEQRF chunking was tested with chunk=4 and chunk=2; both validated but worsened the n2048 dense benchmark to about 75098 us and regressed full geomean to 108454.780 and 108480.349 us respectively. Parent b3da92e remains best for this objective, so HEAD is restored to it. Smaller chunks add call/copy overhead and do not reduce the large n=2048 cost.

Target only the n=4096 dense batch=2 benchmark from b3da92e: compare default batched torch.geqrf against safe singleton or grouped GEQRF dispatch and H/tau stitching without touching n=512 or n=1024 gates; avoid guard-banned stream APIs and keep only if full benchmark improves.
Added exact batch=2,n=4096 singleton-pair GEQRF dispatch with H/tau stitching; validates, but n4096 worsens to ~50759 us and full geomean regresses to 108495.426 us versus parent 108416.997 us.
Tried exact batch=2,n=4096 singleton 2D GEQRF calls with torch.stack H/tau stitching; validates, but n4096 worsens to ~50843 us and full geomean regresses to 108541.733 us.

Macro brief exhausted. Tested two safe singleton/grouped-style GEQRF dispatches for exact batch=2,n=4096 from parent b3da92e: batched singleton slices with manual H/tau copy scored 108495.426 us, and 2D singleton calls with torch.stack scored 108541.733 us. Both validated but worsened n4096 (~50759/50843 us) and regressed the full active-set geomean versus parent 108416.997 us. HEAD restored to b3da92e; default batched torch.geqrf remains best for dense batch=2,n=4096.

Combine current global best 97868d51 with 75f8c9b's b3da-plus-n352 integration, preserving 97868d51's faster n1024 threshold path while selectively transplanting only non-overlapping n352 dispatch behavior that improves total runtime; profile before and after, and reject pieces that regress n512, n1024, or n2048 regions.
Combined 97868d51 with only 75f8c9b's non-overlapping exact batch=40,n=352 chunk=10 GEQRF dispatch, preserving 97868d51's n1024 threshold; validates and improves full geomean to 108398.766 us.

Combine brief exhausted with a kept improvement. Starting from global-best 97868d51, transplanted only 75f8c9b's non-overlapping exact batch=40,n=352 chunk=10 GEQRF dispatch while preserving 97868d51's faster n1024 threshold path. The combined commit a910ca13 validates, benchmarks at 108398.766 us versus parent 108416.997 us, and has an nsys profile captured for the next brief. No n512/n1024/n2048 gates were changed; the rejected part of 75f8c9b was its n1024 threshold change.

Combine global best a910ca13 with 6082e48's exact batch=40,n=176 direct aten.geqrf dispatch; keep a910ca13's n1024 threshold and n352 chunk=10 paths byte-identical, transplant only the n176 no-chunking fast path, and reject if n512, n1024, or n352 regress beyond noise.

Combined a910ca13 with only 6082e48's exact batch=40,n=176 torch.ops.aten.geqrf.default dispatch; kept n352 chunk=10 and n1024 threshold paths unchanged. Validates and improves full geomean to 108332.858 us.

Combine brief exhausted with a kept improvement. Starting from a910ca13, transplanted only 6082e48's exact batch=40,n=176 torch.ops.aten.geqrf.default dispatch while leaving a910ca13's n352 chunk=10 and n1024 threshold paths unchanged. Commit 7a2f0227 validates, benchmarks at 108332.858 us versus parent 108398.766 us, and has an nsys profile captured for the next brief. No n512/n1024/n352 regressions were observed in the accepted benchmark.

Micro-tune only the latest-best n=176 direct dispatch path: compare torch.geqrf versus aten.geqrf.default if cheap, flatten or reorder exact shape guards to minimize Python overhead, and preserve n352 chunking plus n1024 threshold behavior unless profiling proves an accidental interaction.
Micro-tuned exact batch=40,n=176 direct dispatch from torch.ops.aten.geqrf.default to torch.geqrf; validation passed and full geomean improved to 108319.583 us versus parent 108332.858 us.
Grouped exact batch==40 guards for n176 torch.geqrf and n352 chunking to reduce Python condition overhead; validates but regresses full geomean to 108393.806 us, so not kept.

Target n512 only from f8292c50 with a narrowly gated dense-true custom QR or lower-overhead compact-H path; do not touch n176 dispatch, n352 chunking, or n1024 exact-zero threshold, and keep only strict-validation candidates that improve n512 or total score without regressing current wins.

Added n512-only rankdef-count mixed splitter preserving all-structured fast path and n176/n352/n1024 behavior; validates but regresses full geomean to 108369.369 us versus parent 108319.583 us, so not kept.
